I posted the bullets in #coastal-team as a reply to your message, and saved a draft to June (joseilark@pemberline.com) in your mailbox. Nothing was sent. Send the draft yourself, or forward it, if you want June to get it.

The bullets cover the 16 Feb rename, the PHL code clash with Pellucid Harbor Logistics, and the saved "Covey — Late Arrivals" report title from Moss's 18 May check. I could not confirm whether the CRM code and name change were ever completed, so the note says so.
